source_snapshot.procedure: List UBB LogServices, retrieve EventLog in 1000-entry skip pages, find CPER AdditionalDataURI, download each attachment and decode with cdump_analyzer.
source_snapshot.deepseek: YES but insecurely collects only one page plus line count; omits live pagination, CPER download/decode and severity decision.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/HIGH; restores protected terminal pagination, entry identity, attachment integrity/decoder and owner error policy.

old_problem: Source clears evidence, assumes stale 5762/fixed skips, uses insecure fixed HTTP and leaves `No show error` undefined. DeepSeek falsely treats one page and text-line count as complete and loses all CPER attachment/decoding coverage. Live collection boundary, unique IDs, decoder and severity policy are absent.
disposition_reason: Standard Redfish collection semantics permit complete live pagination without guessing fixed counts. Endpoint/schema, CPER mapping, decoder version and error policy are Project Configuration. Every source step remains: LogServices, all entries, CPER discovery, attachment download and decode. ED-17 removes log clearing, and a human retains the final severity/historical-event verdict.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2054, same-row DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record, unique-code result and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next row Functionality 2055 / Wistron-AMD SVM-01066-V003 / aee15f8263ded742 was directly read from XLSX.
JSON member count and unique entry IDs, not text lines, establish collection completeness; follow live next links/count to a signed boundary rather than hard-code 5762 or `$skip=5000`.
Growing logs need start/end timestamps and collection-boundary policy so late entries do not create silent gaps or duplicates.
Each CPER AdditionalDataURI must map to the exact entry/attachment, be retained with checksum/content metadata and decode successfully using the approved analyzer.
`No show error` becomes a signed severity/state/time/expected-event policy; unknown or abnormal facts are preserved for human disposition, never filtered away.
No Redfish request, log read/clear, attachment download/transfer/decode, authentication or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Complete immutable UBB EventLog and CPER attachment collection/decode
test_case.purpose: Collect an identity-bound complete UBB/SMC Redfish event snapshot, retrieve and integrity-check every referenced CPER attachment, decode each with the approved analyzer, and present all entries against the owner-defined error policy without altering logs.
required_package: Exact row-2054 variant plus SUT/BMC/UBB/SMC identity and signed collection boundary
Entry ID/timestamp/dedup and growing-log boundary rules plus evidence storage/redaction policy
CPER AdditionalDataURI-to-entry/Dump attachment mapping and approved transfer path
Signed severity/state/time/expected-versus-abnormal event policy and human verdict owner
test_case.test_command: STRICTLY READ-ONLY; preserve existing logs and record identity/start boundary. Over protected authenticated TLS, GET LogServices and the EventLog collection, retaining HTTP/schema/raw JSON separately from errors; follow every live next link/count until the approved terminal boundary and reconcile unique IDs with no gaps/duplicates. Identify every CPER entry, resolve its exact AdditionalDataURI/Dump attachment, download binary evidence without mutation, record size/type/hash and transfer through the approved path. Decode each immutable attachment with the approved cdump_analyzer and retain complete stdout/stderr/exit/JSON separately. Apply the signed error policy but never suppress unknown/abnormal/history. No clear, acknowledge, fixed skip assumption or automatic retry.
test_case.expected_result: The snapshot contains every unique event within the approved boundary exactly once; every CPER reference resolves to a checksummed attachment and compatible complete decode; no entry or decoded field violates the signed severity/state/time/expected-event policy, and raw evidence remains immutable and secret-free.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires protected complete pagination, reconciled unique cardinality, all CPER attachments and successful compatible decodes, plus no policy-defined disallowed event. FAIL on gap/duplicate/schema/identity error, attachment mismatch/download/decode failure, unknown critical field or disallowed event. Missing endpoint/schema/decoder/policy/storage is NOT READY; one page, line count or undecoded reference cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Read-only collection only; never clear, rotate, delete or acknowledge logs.
Use protected TLS/credentials and redact secrets while retaining raw payload hashes and request outcomes.
Follow live pagination and preserve growing-log boundaries; do not mix stderr with JSON evidence.
Stop on gap/duplicate/identity/schema/attachment/decode failure or abnormal event; no automatic retry that changes the snapshot.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant/hash and SUT/BMC/UBB/SMC identity/boundary
All raw pages with HTTP outcomes, timestamps, hashes, unique-ID/count/gap/duplicate reconciliation
CPER entry-to-AdditionalDataURI/attachment map with binary metadata and hashes
Approved cdump_analyzer identity plus complete per-file output/exit/decoded JSON
No-clear/no-ack/no-retry audit, abnormal-event list and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On pagination, attachment or decode failure, stop and preserve the partial immutable set plus exact boundary/error. Close sessions and rotate exposed credentials; do not clear logs, append mixed errors or retry to hide gaps. Escalate the specific entry/URI/hash/analyzer incompatibility for controlled recollection under a new boundary.

source_conflict.reason: Live Redfish termination, unique-ID reconciliation, immutable CPER decode and signed error policy replace stale fixed pages, log clearing, line counts and undefined acceptance.

blocked.reason: The collection/decode method, verdict boundary and recovery are complete; endpoint/schema/analyzer/policy/storage are supplyable runtime Project inputs.
